relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

nodes.description: First project parser/load step for the vulnerable BAM record. `bam_read1()` reads the first record header from the attacker-controlled stream and materializes the record length and BAM core fields that drive the vulnerable path: `block_len = 73`, `l_qname = 16`, `n_cigar = 2`, and `l_qseq = 10` for the staged witness.

Root cause. After reading `c->l_qname` bytes of qname data into `b->data`, the vulnerable code never checks whether `b->data[c->l_qname - 1]` is `\0` before the record is later exposed via `bam_get_qname(b)`. The fixing patch inserts exactly that missing post-read validation and repair immediately after this statement.

Closest project sink to the ASan crash. `vfprintf` consumes the `%s` argument supplied by `bam_read1()` and scans the unterminated `bam_get_qname(b)` pointer until it crosses the 64-byte heap allocation for `b->data`, producing the reproduced heap-buffer-overflow read.
Intermediate runtime event log_qname materialized from verified transition assertion A-QNAME-BUFFER-FLOWS-TO-LOGGER.

edges.description: The same `b->data` storage filled by the qname read is later passed unchanged as `bam_get_qname(b)` to the logging sink.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `qname_ready.qname_buffer == log_qname.qname_ptr == 0x606000000440`.
